NAME
    changelog - Changelog between deployed and configured input roles

SYNOPSIS

    confctl [global options] changelog [command options] [machine-pattern [role-pattern]]

COMMAND OPTIONS
    -a, --attr=arg        - Filter by attribute (may be used more than once,
                            default: none)
    --cores=number        - Number of CPU cores to be used (see nix build)
                            (default: none)
    -d, --[no-]downgrade  - Show a changelog for downgrade
    -g, --generation=arg  - Show changelog against input roles from selected
                            generation (default: none)
    -j, --max-jobs=number - Maximum number of build jobs (see nix build)
                            (default: none)
    -p, --[no-]patch      - Show patches
    -t, --tag=arg         - Filter by tag (may be used more than once, default:
                            none)
    -v, --[no-]verbose    - Show full-length changelog descriptions
    -y, --[no-]yes        - Assume the answer to confirmations is yes
